acceptedAnswer.text: AI automation is software that uses large language models to handle multi-step tasks across your business tools without a human in the loop. It reads inputs, reasons about them, takes action, and closes the loop.

mainEntity.name: Which workflows should a small business automate first?

acceptedAnswer.text: Start with workflows that meet four conditions: 10+ times a month, predictable trigger, multi-tool, no human judgment on edge cases. Lead follow-up, invoice processing, and customer support are usually the highest-ROI starting points.

mainEntity.name: How much does AI automation cost for a small business?

acceptedAnswer.text: A working stack runs $65 to $300 a month in tool subscriptions. Build costs range from zero (DIY with no-code tools) to $2,000-$10,000 if you hire a freelancer or boutique consultancy. For a typical Hong Kong SMB doing a single workflow, expect HK$500 to HK$1,000 a month in tools and a one-time build of HK$15,000 to HK$40,000 if outsourced. Skip the $50K agency quotes.

mainEntity.name: What's the ROI on AI automation?

acceptedAnswer.text: ROI runs 3x to 10x in year one for workflows that meet the four-condition filter. Payback hits within 6 to 12 weeks for simple cases. Formula: (annual benefits − total annual costs) / total annual costs. Year-one costs include build; year-two drops to just subscriptions, which is why ROI jumps.

mainEntity.name: Do I need a developer to do AI automation?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. You need someone who thinks systematically about workflows. Learn yourself in about 20 hours with no-code tools, or hire help for a fixed-scope audit and build. For 80% of small business workflows in 2026, no developer is needed.

mainEntity.name: What's the difference between AI automation and ChatGPT?

acceptedAnswer.text: ChatGPT is a tool a human uses to do a task faster. AI automation is a system that does the task without a human. ChatGPT helps you write the email. AI automation sends the email, tracks the reply, and books the meeting. Both belong in a small business stack.

mainEntity.name: How long does AI automation take to deliver results?

acceptedAnswer.text: A single straightforward workflow goes from kickoff to running in one to two weeks. Visible results appear within four to six weeks of go-live. Full ROI is clear by month three.

mainEntity.name: Why do AI automation projects fail?

acceptedAnswer.text: 42% of AI initiatives are abandoned before reaching production. The four most common failures are: starting with the tool instead of the problem, feeding the agent bad data (industry surveys cite data issues in around 85% of failed implementations), not measuring results (MIT NANDA 2025 found 95% of generative AI pilots produce zero measurable ROI), and treating it as a set-and-forget project.
